🤖 **devloop code-review** · seed-2.1-pro · ready in 9m 46s

The new integration test `cwd_namespace_matches_common_proot_process_semantics` hard-requires a C compiler at test runtime. It invokes `Command::new("cc")...output().expect("compile cwd fixture")` without first checking that `cc` exists, so on a Linux host without a C compiler (no `cc` in PATH) the `output()` call returns `Err` and the `expect` panics, failing the whole test binary. This diverges from the sibling Go coverage test in `tests/linux_cow.rs`, which checks `go` availability and skips gracefully. The fixture test should do the same: probe for a working `cc` and skip (or otherwise degrade) when it is absent, keeping `cargo test` green on minimal Linux environments/CI images.
